assumptions: equal ring widths and generated gaps

pentagon.scope: Exterior massing only. No rooms, security installations, parking or access-control layout.

clock dial diameter is a nominal modelling value in this slice
round segmented arch and simplified gables
local front is +Z, not a verified geographic bearing
